 def memo_put(key: str, value: dict) -> None:

+    _memo_cleanup()

+def _memo_cleanup() -> None:
+    """Remove all expired entries from the in-process cache."""
+    now = time.time()
+    expired = [k for k, (stored_at, _) in _MEMO.items()
+               if now - stored_at > app.config.CACHE_TTL]

+

             return None

+        if time.time() - path.stat().st_mtime > app.config.CACHE_TTL:
+            try:
+                path.unlink()
+            except FileNotFoundError:
+                pass
             return None

+        if not self.directory.exists():
